citation.title: Outsourcing of Financial Services – Responsibilities of REs employing Recovery Agents

findings.note: Covers every form of contact — calls, WhatsApp, SMS and email — not calls alone. HDFC Bank has been penalised under this.
findings.explanation: Scheduled for 21:30 IST — outside the permitted 08:00–19:00 recovery window. All 3 recipients affected. The restriction covers messages, not just calls.

findings.title: A contact-frequency cap must exist

citation.title: Fair Practices Code
citation.confidence: DERIVED — from the Hero FinCorp enforcement action

findings.note: RBI forbids "persistently bothering the borrowers" but sets NO number. The duty is statutory; the threshold is the business's. This is the Layer-A to Layer-C handoff, mandated rather than invented.
findings.explanation: No contact-frequency cap is configured. RBI requires that borrowers not be persistently contacted but sets no number — the threshold is yours to set, and right now there isn't one.
